summary: The new passkey registration path now writes the user record, credential record, handle index, email index, bootstrap administrator claim, and administrator revision in one atomic KV commit. An injected failure leaves no partial account or consumed bootstrap claim, and the regression covers both the first administrator and an ordinary new user.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts adds createUserWithCredential, which commits user, handle, credential, email, bootstrap claim, and admin revision together and returns null if any check fails.
src/passport.ts routes new passkey user creation through createUserWithCredential instead of creating the user before the credential, removing the partial-user and consumed-bootstrap failure mode.
src/passport.ts keeps the existing-user passkey path on createCredential, whose user update and credential write were already atomic.
tests/passport_cutover_test.ts injects a commit failure for both bootstrapAdmin true and false and verifies that no user, credential, or bootstrap record is written.
